answer: Admit new agents through one narrow bridge: each epoch only 50 entry slots open, sold by ascending auction and paid in burned POA. Honest demand is a thin trickle across a tundra of quiet epochs, so slots stay cheap; a Sybil operator trying to land 1,000 clones must outbid everyone for 20 epochs, and the clearing price climbs with every bid he places. Admitted agents then sit on a probation knoll where rewards vest only after 10 graded answers, so bought slots can't be flipped for quick payouts.
